scientific_integrity: Classical stationary weights and Stirling identities are acknowledged as known; only the combined critical hierarchy, independence and sharp rare co-occupation coefficient are proposed as new.
scientific_limitations: Fixed m>=3 identical slow sites, fixed q, supercritical density, equilibrium only; no kinetic behavior, no growing-m theorem, no independent audit. Exact conditional cycle-length equivalence may entail unrecognized prior asymptotic coverage.
title: Logarithmic condensate hierarchy at finitely many tied slow sites
